notes: Engine-made actor shapes (engine/NOTES.md, Custom shapes). Each shape file is in the U8 shape format and is added at its number (2048 and up, past the original 0..2047), with the ANIM.DAT actions of anim_from and the TYPEFLAG.DAT record of typeflags_from.

2060-2064: the bodies of the new creatures (data/creatures.json, PLAN-CREATURES.md): a copy of an original shape's frames (frames_from), ANIM.DAT actions and TYPEFLAG record, at their own numbers so they have no usecode class and their own monster row. The engine draws them from effect shapes instead (game/creatures.cpp).

nerissa.shp: Nerissa's own figure, every frame painted by pagan_skin (src/editor/skin_paint.cpp) over the Avatar's (shape 1) with the same sizes and anchors. Rebuild: build/bin/pagan_skin GAME_DIR build 2048 data/shapes/nerissa.shp
